definition: to take someone away by force and hold them
hook: Kidnap is two slang words that were stuck together in the 1600s.
modernAnchor: A black van, a ransom note, a headline. We call it a kidnapping.
journey: Kid was slang for a child, and nap was a dialect word meaning to snatch or seize.
Put together, a kidnapper was a person who snatched children.
In the late 1600s children were stolen and shipped to the American colonies to work as servants.
The word outgrew its victims, and now anyone who is seized and held has been kidnapped.
